snippet.title: Warframe | Isleweaver Official Gameplay Trailer - Available Now On All Platforms!
snippet.description:
The time has come to return to the floating kingdom of Duviri!

Dominus Thrax has been usurped by Major Neci Rusalka and the Murmur as the Indifference encroaches...

Fight back and stop their invasion before it's too late. Experience an exciting new twist on Duviri gameplay, master the arachnid huntress Oraxia, and earn a brand new Incarnon Scythe (among other Rewards) during Operation: Eight Claw!

Learn more about Isleweaver here: https://www.warframe.com/isleweaver

►► WHAT IS WARFRAME? 

Join 84M+ registered players in Warframe, a cooperative, free-to-play third-person looter shooter set in a constantly evolving sci-fi universe. For more info, visit https://warframe.com.
